subject: BlueCrest audit: SDLC evidence request and delivery plan
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@bluecrest-audit.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: auditteam@bluecrest.com
Date: Wed, 10 Apr 2029 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review - BlueCrest intake

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake for BlueCrest we need a compact package showing your secure SDLC controls focused on: code review processes, CI/CD controls (pipeline access, approvals, deploy gating), secrets management (vault usage, rotation cadence), and change management (approval calendar, emergency patch handling).

Can you provide the following (ideally within 72 hours):
- A single evidence manifest describing each artifact and why it maps to the control (short bullet per artifact)
- Export of recent code-review metrics (last 90 days) and one sample PR with reviewer history
- CI pipeline screenshot showing enforced gating + link to the pipeline config
- Secrets management summary (KMS/HSM integration, rotation cadence, ephemeral creds)
- Any runbooks for emergency change/rollback (high level)

Attachments are fine as PDFs/CSVs. If you prefer, a Drive folder with access works too; please include a readme. We may follow up with a couple of short clarifying questions.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Audit Manager — BlueCrest Compliance Services
Samantha Lee | BlueCrest Financial

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 16:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: SDLC artifacts for SIG/SOC2 review - BlueCrest intake

Marissa / Irene,

Quick update — pulled artifacts and attaching exports. Summary below, artifacts attached: evidence_manifest_v2.pdf (maps artifacts to SIG items), code_review_export_apr2029.csv (last 90 days aggregated), ci_pipeline_screenshot_20290411.png (example pipeline showing approval gates).

High-level mapping:
- Code review: All PRs require at least one peer reviewer and automated CI checks. The CSV includes reviewer list, timestamps, and automated check status. Median review turnaround (last 90d) = 4.2 hours. Sample PR: PR #8421 (linked in CSV) shows two reviewers, comment thread, and merge only after green checks.
- CI/CD controls: Our pipeline in GitHub Actions + internal runner enforces a required approval step for deploy-to-prod. The screenshot shows the protected-environment approval step. The pipeline config (available in the drive link) uses secrets from KMS and requires signed commits for release branches.
- Secrets management: We use AWS KMS for envelope encryption, with secrets proxied by Vault (transit + dynamic credentials via AWS IAM role assumptions). Rotation: database user passwords rotated via Vault dynamic creds every 24h for short-lived workloads; service-level long-lived keys rotated quarterly.
- Change management: We maintain an approval calendar in Confluence and use a deploy window policy; emergency patches follow the "expedited change" runbook (see manifest). Rollbacks are automated via canary rollback in the pipeline.

Attachments: evidence_manifest_v2.pdf, ci_pipeline_screenshot_20290411.png, code_review_export_apr2029.csv

Let me know if you want a redacted sample PR PDF instead of raw CSV; we can also export the pipeline YAML if they need config snippets.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
